allowed_claim_language: Modulo 1 collapses every integer value in the named source domain.
Retained edge occurrences expose provenance that the residue quotient erases.
The quotient topology at modulus 1 is a negative control, not a discovered structure.
disallowed_claim_language: Do not say modulo 1 proves that 0 and 1 are identical in the source graph.
Do not call a collapse of all rational nodes Gaussian congruence.
Do not attribute retained graph diversity to arithmetic inside Z/1Z.
Do not treat an external Gauss framing as MoO runtime semantics or validation.

alignment.operand_rule: positive-spine strict corpus: only confirmed positive-spine iterations may be operands

interpretation_limits: Gauss's congruence is applied only to integer-valued nodes and results.
The all-integer shadow includes unconfirmed and relational integers; its status fields must not be erased.
The confirmed-positive domain is a corpus-specific control, not all of Z.
Non-integer rational phase modulo 1 is Q/Z and is not a one-class ring quotient.
Exact integer division is checked as b*c congruent to a, not as unrestricted residue division.
All findings are conditioned on the named finite corpus and checkpoints.
A singleton quotient does not imply 0=1 in the unprojected source graph.

neighborhood_query.interpretation: Inspect the source edge ids and node statuses inside each residue fiber; the quotient node alone has no neighborhood resolution at m=1.
neighborhood_query.source_edges: SELECT e.edge_id,e.stage,e.op,l.label,r.label,o.label FROM edges e LEFT JOIN nodes l ON l.node_id=e.left_node_id LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.node_id=e.right_node_id JOIN nodes o ON o.node_id=e.result_node_id WHERE e.stage<=:U AND o.q=1 ORDER BY e.stage,e.edge_id

one_bucket_control.control_result: Any one-bucket value projection has the same bare one-node loop topology. Modulus 1 contributes no topology-specific signal; only source fibers and retained decorations carry information.

projection_or_filter.edge_policy: Decorate every retained source edge with residues; never deduplicate edge occurrences into a bare quotient edge.
projection_or_filter.primary_domain: all integer-valued source nodes first seen by the checkpoint and all retained integer-result edge occurrences
projection_or_filter.primary_projection: integer node label n maps to least residue n mod m
projection_or_filter.strict_control_domain: confirmed positive-spine nodes through the checkpoint and edge occurrences whose results are among those nodes

why_flagged: Modulo 1 erases every integer value distinction. It therefore tests whether MoO reports preserve construction evidence independently of value.
